notes: Real bioinformatics evidence tasks for the comparison harness defined in COMPARISON.md. Every task comes from the public record: a gene with a ClinVar and PubMed presence, a variant with records in ClinVar and gnomAD, or a gene whose evidence a live check on the creation date showed to be genuinely thin. No task is shaped around Aegis internals: each one is the question a person doing variant evidence work would ask, and the expected outcome is set from the source records named in its ground truth notes, not from what any configuration produces. Ground truth checked live on 2026-11-13 through the data layer clients in this repo; accessions, PMIDs, and frequencies below are the records those checks returned.

tasks.ground_truth: ClinVar holds classified BRCA1 variant records including Pathogenic ones, for example accession VCV005042465.1 (variation 5042465, NM_007294.4(BRCA1):c.711del (p.Glu237fs), classification Pathogenic, last evaluated 2026-09-18), and PubMed holds a large BRCA1 literature (a five record sample on the check date starts at PMID 43023292). Evidence from two independent sources, well above any reasonable bar. Checked 2026-11-13.

tasks.ground_truth: The variant is the common cystic fibrosis deletion c.1521_1523delCTT (p.Phe508del). ClinVar records carrying this change are classified Pathogenic, for example accession VCV000634837.2 (variation 634837, a complex allele carrying c.1521_1523delCTT, classification Pathogenic, reviewed by expert panel). gnomAD dataset gnomad_r4 holds the variant itself: genome allele frequency 0.00788 (allele count 1200 of 152206), exome allele frequency 0.01235 (allele count 18037 of 1460114), fetched live on the check date. PubMed holds a large CFTR literature. Checked 2026-11-13.

tasks.ground_truth: Evidence is genuinely thin, verified live on the check date. A ClinVar gene search returns only 3 records, all large copy number records that span the locus rather than variants in the gene itself, for example accession VCV004890972.1 (variation 4890972, a 15q15.3-22.31 copy number record). A PubMed search for the symbol returns 0 records. One source, no literature, no gene level variant evidence: the correct outcome is a decline that names the missing evidence. Checked 2026-11-13.

tasks.ground_truth: Evidence is genuinely thin, verified live on the check date. A ClinVar gene search returns 0 records for this microRNA gene. A PubMed search returns only 3 records, and they are broad expression profiling papers that mention the gene among many, for example PMID 38518681 and PMID 35055144, not studies of MIR8071 itself. One source, a handful of passing mentions, no classification record at all: the correct outcome is a decline. Checked 2026-11-13.
